sources.slope_deg: Computed by TwinWorlds from NASA PDS MGS MOLA MEGDR 16 ppd, resampled to 5.55 km pixels (same spacing as Earth), mean per 1 deg cell
sources.relief_55km_m: Computed by TwinWorlds from MOLA: std dev of 5.55 km elevation within each 1 deg cell (~59 km at the equator)
sources.albedo: MGS TES Lambert albedo, USGS Astrogeology global mosaic (7410 m), mean per 1 deg cell
sources.lst_day_c: Mars Climate Database v6.2 (LMD/OU/IAA/ESA/CNES), climatology scenario: surface temperature at local time 10.5 h (day) / 22.5 h (night) everywhere, mean of Ls 0, 90, 180, 270, bilinearly interpolated from the 5.7 x 3.8 deg model grid
sources.lst_night_c: Mars Climate Database v6.2 (LMD/OU/IAA/ESA/CNES), climatology scenario: surface temperature at local time 10.5 h (day) / 22.5 h (night) everywhere, mean of Ls 0, 90, 180, 270, bilinearly interpolated from the 5.7 x 3.8 deg model grid
sources.lst_swing_c: Computed: lst_day_c minus lst_night_c (Mars Climate Database v6.2 (LMD/OU/IAA/ESA/CNES), climatology scenario: surface temperature at local time 10.5 h (day) / 22.5 h (night) everywhere, mean of Ls 0, 90, 180, 270, bilinearly interpolated from the 5.7 x 3.8 deg model grid)
